text:
emma: Quick kickoff — VaultCo agreed to a 30m case interview TOMORROW 9:30am PT. Need legal to confirm quote language and embargo window. Planning webinar with their Head of CS the following week (Wed 5/12). Also want to route webinar signups to a dedicated SDR queue 'vaultco-webinar'. Can legal and demand gen weigh in?

zach: I can run the recording ops at 9:30. Will send calendar + pre-interview brief. Do we need a release form?

courtney: Please paste the exact quote you want to publish. Also confirm: do we have permission for logo use? Release form yes — I can draft a one-paragraph release and a simple redaction checklist.

nina: For the webinar, recommend a standalone registration page and UTM tags: utm_source=vaultco&utm_campaign=vaultco-webinar. We can webhook signups to Salesforce to a queue named "VaultCo Webinar". Need preview assets: 1-pager + 2 15-30s soundbites for promo.

alex: For the blog/benchmark narrative we need the 95th pctl latency and cost-per-1k-tokens or a conservative delta vs baseline. If legal won't clear hard numbers we can use relative phrasing like "substantial reduction".

emma: Pasting the three candidate quote snippets the customer said in the last call — these are verbatim (will ask them to repeat tomorrow):
```
"We used Redwood Inference to move our inference load to dedicated GPUs, and it cut our per-request latency by about 40% during peak windows."
"By switching to Redwood's batching and KV cache, we saw roughly a 50% reduction in GPU cost on our dialog flows."
"The rollout was smooth — ops team hit the SLA targets from day one, which let us keep the feature in front of users."
```

zach: Got it. I'll capture each line as separate soundbites during the interview. Will also attach consent verbiage to the invite.

courtney: Redlines: flagging the "50% reduction" claim — we need backup (metrics snapshot or written confirmation). Also the customer approved quotes but declined logo use without a separate logo release. We can publish quotes + company name, but only if VaultCo confirms in writing. If they don't want the name public, we'll anonymize.

nina: For lead routing, here's a sample webhook payload we can use (we'll mask tokens in prod):
```
POST /webhook/salesforce HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source": "vaultco-webinar",
  "email": "{registrant_email}",
  "name": "{registrant_name}",
  "utm_campaign": "vaultco-webinar",
  "target_queue": "VaultCo Webinar"
}
```

alex: If legal wants to avoid raw numbers, we can add a brief benchmarking appendix in the blog (gated) that includes the exact metrics for customers who request more detail. Keeps the public claim conservative.

emma: I'll update the invite with a short pre-interview brief + consent checkbox. Tentative embargo request from the customer: publish earliest 2026-05-15 08:00 PT. Courtney, can you confirm if that fits legal review timelines?

courtney: Embargo 2026-05-15 08:00 PT is fine as long as we get sign-off by 5/12 EOD. I'll review the quote text this afternoon and send a redlined version. Also will prepare a one-paragraph release for signature.

zach: Calendar invite created and sent. Recording prep doc is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-vaultco (placeholder). I'll add the soundbite bullet list and consent language.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite "VaultCo case interview" created by zach for 2026-05-05 09:30 PT.

emma: Awesome — tagging @courtney for quick sign-off before 5/12. I'll also add a column to the launch playbook for lead routing steps and SDR handoff notes. :rocket:
